notes: «رُوِيَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى أَنَّهُ قَالَ» opens the chain with Hammad; the Imam is named only in the words after it (Owner ruling 2); the rest is Hammad's own account.

fixes.reason: RWY reads the passive verb «روي» and the pronoun «أنه» as transmitters; the text gives Hammad b. Isa as the first link.

evidence.quote: رُوِيَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى أَنَّهُ
